svg.title: From Rust code to English and Chinese user interfaces
svg.desc: Three stages use the supplied sprinkler examples. First, Rust types, constraints, and English documentation comments define a configuration form. Libertas generates an English settings interface with Water amount, No-watering periods, and Active. Translating the English labels and descriptions into Simplified Chinese produces the same interface with 水量, 禁止浇水时段, and 启用. Translation preserves the code, data structure, controls, and runtime behavior.

g.text: From code to UI, in two languages
Types define the controls. Comments supply the English text. Translation adds Chinese.
